reviews.body: We bring this with us to hotels to be able to have a real cup of coffee.I would always complain about the little coffee makers where you make single cups.Even though keurig is a single cup it is Good coffee.We would leave hotels searching for a good coffee and now we do not have that worry.Yes we bring our own keurig cups but it’s worth it.The machine travels well also!.

reviews.title: Compact, brews quickly with a few downsides
reviews.body: Nice compact coffee maker.  It brews fairly quickly. A few downsides:  it sprays at the end of the drip cycle wetting the countertop,  it doesn't accept my K-cups that I can fill with my favorite coffee and, lastly, when I insert a new K-cup and close the lid the "ready" light doesn't light up. I have to re-open it, close it again and then it will light up so I can press the button to start the cycle. Not a deal breaker, just an annoyance. So far it's worked well for the month that I've had it. If anything goes awry later on I'll update my review.

features: Fits Anywhere: Less than 5 inches wide, the Keurig K-Mini Single Serve Coffee Maker is perfect for small spaces
Your Perfect Amount: Brew any cup size between 6 to 12oz with Keurig K-Cup pods
One Cup Reservoir: Just add fresh water for each brew.
Travel Mug Friendly: Removable drip tray accommodates travel mugs up to 7.0 inches tall and holds a full accidental brew for easy cleanup
Energy Efficient: Auto off feature turns off your coffee maker 90 seconds after your last brew, helping to save energy
